clayresearch.delta: Represent semantic content identity, semantic history/version identity and execution/replay identity as separate typed layers rather than one overloaded root.

frank.delta: Franks authoritative state/replay contract needs explicit content, history/version and execution identities; no Frank self-Harness authority follows.

gwt.delta: No GWT mechanism change; GWT receipts should bind the appropriate versioned/trace identity without treating the hash itself as causal evidence.

emergenz.delta: No emergence promotion; identity correctness is an instrumentation prerequisite only.

claycode.delta: Expose distinct typed identities for StateContentHash/SemanticEventHash/SemanticHistoryHash/VersionedStateRoot/ExecutionChainHash/TraceRootHash; do not overload ProgramSemanticId.

hyperposition.delta: No topology mechanism change; alternative/schedule traces should bind VersionedStateRoot plus TraceRootHash.

claygraph.delta: Dynamic Run ClayGraph deltas should bind semantic content and versioned state roots separately from execution trace root.

unifieddb.delta: Persist/query content identity separately from event/history/version and execution-chain identity; idempotency records must bind semantic request fingerprint.

harness.delta: Do not promote either duplicate H-WP-02 ledger unchanged. Merge the strongest properties and run common crash/replay/concurrency/tamper differential corpus.
